question: Simplify the following expression: (3x + 17 - 2y)(3x - 17 - 2y)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rearrange the given expression to group similar terms together:

⇒ [(3x − 2y) + 17] × [(3x − 2y) − 17]

Apply the difference of squares formula (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²:

⇒ (3x − 2y)² − 17²

⇒ 9x² − 12xy + 4y² − 289

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² − 12xy + 4y² − 289.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (3x + 17 − 2y)(3x − 17 − 2y)

**Formula Used:**

Distributive property: (a + b + c)(d + e + f) = ad + ae + af + bd + be + bf + cd + ce + cf

**Calculations:**

Multiply each term of the first polynomial by each term of the second polynomial:

⇒ 3x(3x − 17 − 2y) + 17(3x − 17 − 2y) − 2y(3x − 17 − 2y)

⇒ (9x² − 51x − 6xy) + (51x − 289 − 34y) + (−6xy + 34y + 4y²)

Combine the like terms:

⇒ 9x² + (−51x + 51x) + (−6xy − 6xy) + (−34y + 34y) + 4y² − 289

⇒ 9x² + 0 − 12xy + 0 + 4y² − 289

⇒ 9x² − 12xy + 4y² − 289

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² − 12xy + 4y² − 289.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities

Some common and useful algebraic identities include (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b², (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b², and a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b).

Distributive Property in Polynomials

When multiplying two polynomials, you must multiply each term in the first polynomial by every term in the second polynomial. Grouping and combining like terms simplifies the final expression efficiently.
